steps: STOP the offending agent immediately (serotonergic drug or antipsychotic).
Aggressive cooling and IV fluids; benzodiazepines for agitation/rigidity; ICU for severe cases.
Serotonin syndrome: consider cyproheptadine. NMS: consider dantrolene ± bromocriptine.
Monitor for and treat rhabdomyolysis, hyperthermia, renal failure and DIC.
Supportive care; avoid restraints worsening hyperthermia.

confirm: Hyperthermia, rigidity and altered mental state with autonomic instability - serotonergic excess (clonus, hyperreflexia, rapid onset) vs NMS (lead-pipe rigidity, antipsychotic, slower).
